definition: a column whose every non-blank value across the whole table is one single ISO date. Detected by full scan, never sampled.
caveat: a single-date column in a table that legitimately covers one day is a FALSE POSITIVE of this test. The constant value is printed beside every column so a reader can tell the two apart; nothing here is auto-fixed.
worked_example: code/77_build_nagpra_dataset.py::cache_fetched_date - derive the date from the cached artifact, leave it BLANK when the artifact cannot say. That single change made nagpra_notices.csv byte-reproducible.
